title_candidates: Gemini 3.6 Flash is faster, leaner, and available now
summary: Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash improves coding, knowledge work, and multimodal tasks while using fewer output tokens, with access in the Gemini app and AI Studio.

primary_source.title: Introducing Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite, and 3.5 Flash Cyber
primary_source.author: Google
key_facts: Gemini 3.6 Flash is available in the Gemini app, AI Studio, API, and enterprise products.
Google reports improved coding, knowledge work, computer use, and multimodal performance.
Google reports 17% fewer output tokens than 3.5 Flash on the Artificial Analysis Index.
API pricing is $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens.
The model accepts text, images, video, audio, and PDFs with a one-million-token input window.
Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber is restricted to a limited government and trusted-partner pilot.
